# laravelforge_site_deployment (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge site deployment (deployment history) by ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the deployment.
- `organization` (String) Slug of the Forge organization that owns the site.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site runs on.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site the deployment belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `ended_at` (String) Timestamp the deployment ended.
- `started_at` (String) Timestamp the deployment started.
- `status` (String) Deployment status (e.g. `pending`, `deploying`, `finished`, `failed`, `cancelled`).
- `type` (String) Deployment type.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
